items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: INTERVIEWER: 'Muggsy saw me, and sort of Darnell, he recognized me.'

ctx.x: I didn't see you when you were coming in.

Yeah, you didn't see us. We kept looking at you, and Muggsy saw me, and sort of Darnell, he recognized me. I used to know Darnell, a lot of us were talking with you, we kept looking into you, and you wouldn't look at that, I thought you'd see bass.

I was looking at it, I must be watching somebody. You were taking the business, you were playing. I must be watching somebody, there's their legs all up, and I'm always watching something like that. Oh, fair one? There's a chick sitting there, legs all up, right? I'm playing. I'm playing. I'm playing.

items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I couldn't remember that either. I was trying to think. I don't know where it would. It has to be in Chicago.

ctx.x: I couldn't remember that either. I was trying to think. I don't know where it would. It has to be in Chicago. It had to be in Chicago. I got a strong idea. It was either at the apex or the other. Upstairs at the apex, I didn't know if it was there. I used to come over there and go downstairs to shoot crafts or something. Downstairs, you know, to gamble downstairs in Jim Newman. Yeah. Then I didn't even have another little job on 39th Street. Was it Cuisbro? Yeah. Somewhere around in there. Near there. I went back…
Well, that project just starts on 39th Street now. Yeah. The place you think about was the Palais Royal. Was that it? 39th and Drone.
